{{Quote|This Volume contains the experience and research of one of the most esteemed members of our Order and one of the greatest scholars of our time.|[[Satele Shan]] on ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural''|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>}}
'''''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural''''' was a book composed by Grand Master [[Satele Shan]] who pieced together key entries from the journal that Master [[Gnost-Dural]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] famous in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], kept. This book details Master Dural's experiences as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and maps his rise to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and keeper of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. It also provides insight into major events in the conflict between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] including; The [[Force Wars]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the return of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], The [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], The [[Battle of Alderaan]], The [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]], and The [[Sacking of Coruscant]].

==Chapter One, "On the History of the Jedi Order"==
{{Quote|As Padawans, we are forced to spend a great deal of time in the Jedi Archives. While some of my fellow pupils find this tedious, I find it to be absolutely fascinating| [[Gnost-Dural]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)" />}}
[[File:Force_Wars-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Force Wars]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].]]

The first chapter of this journal contains entries set only in the time frame where [[Gnost-Dural]] was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Throughout this chapter, Dural voices his interest in the ancient [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. He tells of what he uncovers in the archives about the discovery of [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] on Tython and the conflict between the [[Tythan]]s who desired to use [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] for good and those who desired to use it for evil. He also tells of how he was disappointed to learn of the destruction on Tython and that he hopes the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] soon locate the ancient planet, so he can study the writings of the Order's ancient predecessors. In a comment later written into the journal, [[Satele Shan]] tells of how [[Gnost-Dural]] later helped tremendously in the locating of Tython. Towards the end of the chapter, Dural tells how the focus of his studies shifted to the system of governance within [[Galactic Republic|The Republic]].

==Chapter Two, "The Return of the Sith Empire"==
{{Quote|I watched with disbelief as the star cruisers opened fire on the diplomatic ships with no warning whatsoever.| [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Gnost-Dural on seeing news-cast holo-screens of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ambush on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] cruisers|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)" />}}
The second chapter of this journal tells of the return of the dreaded [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The events take place after Dural has become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Dural first tells of a news-casted attack on a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ship (near the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|''Tingel Arm'']] region). He explains that at that point, no one knew who the attackers were or what they wanted, which left him very uneasy. In his next entry, he explained that these attackers were the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and that the attack he saw was not the only one. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were attacking Republic vessels across the Galaxy. He related that these were the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], not [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Fallen Jedi]] proclaiming themselves to be [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but the remnants of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] species from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. These Sith, he noted, were the descendants of survivors of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Not surprisingly, their very first strike, even before the attack near the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] was on a Republic space station above [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. He tells that amazingly, a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] escaped this attack and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to tell the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] of what transpired. Ironically, this young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was [[Satele Shan]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who composed and commented in this journal. She tells in writing next to Dural's entry the story of her duel with [[Darth Malgus]] and how her Master, [[Kao Cen Darach]], sacrificed himself so she could escape.

==Chapters Three and Four, The Early Days of the Great War and The Battle of Bothawui==
[[File:Bothawui_news.jpg|thumb|right|250px|News of the Republic's victory at Bothawui spreads across the galaxy.]]{{Quote|This is my first journal entry in several weeks, because we have been very busy since I was transferred to serve with the Republic fleet.| [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)" />}}
This group of entries is very disorganized and spread apart, just as the Republic military was at the time. Dural was called into combat and traveled to the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] to defend the Republic. He also tells of the noble efforts of [[Belth Allusis]] in the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]].Throughout these chapters, his entries are fairly vague and it is clear that some information is being withheld.

==Chapters Five and Six, Studying the History of the Sith Empire, and The Mystery of the Sith Emperor==
[[File:Sith_Emperor.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Sith Emperor on his throne]]
{{Quote|We have successfully completed a vital mission. I have kept all reference to it out of this journal because of its highly confidential nature, but I can now safely relay the details.| [[Gnost-Dural]] on the recent success of his mission to locate and destroy the [[Dread Masters]]|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)" />}}
In these chapters, Dural tells of his mission to destroy the [[Dread Masters]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had mastered the art of [[Battle meditation/Legends|Battle meditation]] to the point that they would inflict an awful, mysterious terror upon members of any given Republic cruiser. In order to avoid being compromised, they kept in constant motion in an Imperial dreadnaught that roamed the galaxy. With the help of an Elite [[Republic Special Forces Division]] team, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] infilitrated the dreadnaught and captured the [[Dread Masters]]. While they provided no information on the illusive [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], the data aboard their vessel did. The data revealed that not even the Emperor's loyal subjects know who he is, only his [[Dark Council]] knows his true identity. The data also revealed that although Imperials did not and do not know who the Emperor is, they do know that he was a hero in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and that he used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] to increase his longevity. He has been commanding his armies from [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the seat of the Empire. Jaric destroyed the vessel after he recovered the intel and falsely reported to the public that the [[Dread Masters]] were dead, trying to cover the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] tracks. Dural wrote a report for the archives on the Sith Emperor based on the intel found in the Imperial dreadnaught. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] not only read and approved his report, but they conferred upon him the title of Jedi Master.

==Chapters 7-10, from the Battle of Alderaan to the Sacking of Coruscant==
[[File:Gnost_Archives.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gnost-Dural consulting the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]]]
{{Quote|This will be my final entry in this journal. Grand Master Satele Shan has asked that I begin rebuilding the Jedi Archives here on Tython, and as daunting a task as that may be, I do intend to give myself fully to it.| Master [[Gnost-Dural]] in his last entry|<ref name="The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)" />}}
The last chapters of Dural's Journal detail The [[Battle of Alderaan]], The [[Sacking of Coruscant]], and the events after [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Anyone familiar with The [[Sacking of Coruscant]] knows that in the attack, the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was totaled along with the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] contained inside. This especially bothered Dural because of his special love for knowledge. Not suprisingly, he was selected to begin building the new [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on the ancient planet of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Behind the scenes==
The real-life version of this book is included in the Collector's Edition of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It tells of the events before the game and helps set the stage. It is written by Rob Chestney and was published by [[Chronicle Books]] in 2011. The book features artwork by Sperasoft Studios, Roman Artamonov, Fedor Losev, Lorenz Hideyoshi Ruwwe, Clint Young, and Arnie Jorgensen, as well as maps and diagrams by Michael Voigt.
